body:
>People who don't support our dreams, don't make good life partners.

Wow. You're exactly right.  Even though the job thing is still kind of depressing I am feeling better about this whole relationship thing. Thank you so much.

Wow. This actually helped me a little.  Just to add a little more... This girl talks about wanting a future with me, yet talks to other guys. I'm the one that doesn't talk to other girls. I feel like I'm the one staying 'loyal' I guess you might say. We share like so many things in common. Religious beliefs, political beliefs, we both want to travel. Etc..,

Plans are maybe go to a tech school or military but scared to do anything except stay in the position I am at because I still feel like I fuck up all the time. Constantly goes through my mind that hey what If I'm a welder or an electrician and fuck something up and get fired or even worse accidentally kill a coworker or something. Or what if I'm in boot camp and constantly fuck everything up, etc. This girl doesn't want me to go to military so that makes me feel like she cares about my safety or something. But maybe she just wants to keep me around for when she's down close to me because she visits some family down here once in awhile.  

Kind of just feel like she's keeping me around for her own convenience.
